note: Optional per-species homepage cover overrides. Each value is an image filename (e.g. '03.webp') inside public/trilobites/<slug>/. Entries here are used everywhere (homepage card, schema image, og:image) and take highest priority. When empty, the cover is auto-picked by lib/trilobites.ts getCover(): prefer captions without digits (collector photos) ranked by colorfulness and complete-specimen wording, falling back to the first image.
